guidebook.intro: On the phone: calls, messages and meeting up.

tips.title: Aŋari iyoŋ esimu
body: **Esimu** is the phone. **Aŋari iyoŋ esimu** is “I call you”, **Kiŋar eoŋ esimu** “call me”. A call starts with **Halo** and **Ŋai erworo?** (who is speaking?).

tips.title: Koriamakis oni
body: **Koriamakis oni** is “let’s meet”. **Akilari iyoŋ** is “I am waiting for you”, and **Ejai eoŋ ko erot** “I’m on the way”.

culture.title: Phones and mobile money
body: Even in the villages almost everyone has a phone, and money is sent by phone to relatives in town and back.
